name: Taintward: Blast radius (who else saw it)
description: For each tainted run, how many distinct tools/destinations the sensitive data reached, the GDPR Art. 30 disclosure-recipients / Art. 15 access surface. A run that touched external+llm+log has a larger blast radius than one that stayed internal.

queries.title: Blast radius per trace (distinct tools + destinations touched by the taint)
queries.sql: SELECT trace_id, uniqExact(name) AS tools_touched, uniqExact(attributes_string['taintward.destination']) AS distinct_destinations, groupArrayDistinct(attributes_string['taintward.destination']) AS destinations, countIf(attributes_bool['taintward.policy.violation'] = 1) AS violations, countIf(attributes_bool['taintward.policy.transfer_violation'] = 1) AS cross_border_transfers FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3 WHERE serviceName = 'taintward-hr-bot' AND attributes_bool['taintward.sensitive'] = 1 GROUP BY trace_id ORDER BY violations DESC

queries.title: Top leak surfaces (destination classes that most often receive tainted data)
queries.sql: SELECT attributes_string['taintward.destination'] AS destination, count() AS tainted_spans, countIf(attributes_bool['taintward.policy.violation'] = 1) AS violations FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3 WHERE serviceName = 'taintward-hr-bot' AND attributes_bool['taintward.sensitive'] = 1 GROUP BY destination ORDER BY violations DESC

queries.title: Cross-border transfers (Art. 44) by jurisdiction
queries.sql: SELECT attributes_string['taintward.jurisdiction'] AS jurisdiction, attributes_string['taintward.destination'] AS destination, count() AS transfer_violations FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3 WHERE serviceName = 'taintward-hr-bot' AND attributes_bool['taintward.policy.transfer_violation'] = 1 GROUP BY jurisdiction, destination ORDER BY transfer_violations DESC

notes: Blast radius = Art. 30 disclosure recipients + Art. 15 access scope, derived from the live taint graph. DLP 'sequence detection' (collection -> evasion -> exfil) reduces to this same blast-radius view.
